_comment: a.js calls functions from b.js before b.js initializes them, because both are in one import cycle. main.js calls `later` before its declaration. These calls must stay and throw. The body of `later` has a side effect, because oxc can remove a call of a side-effect-free function before its declaration, with or without the annotation. The calls of the function declarations, of the function from c.js, outside the cycle, and of `annotated`, after its declaration, should be removed. The bare entry checks a call outside a try statement.
